prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: Ash Shaft inventory icon, ash, turned down and oiled, resistant to woodland damp. Generate one polished grounded fantasy photoreal 3D product render of a long straight turned ash shaft. Creamy tan ash wood with strong dark flowing growth lines with readable natural longitudinal grain, subtle fine lathe shaping and beveled cut ends. Plain crafting intermediate, no hardware or decoration. Diagonally bottom left to upper right, entire object visible, substantial thickness readable at 48px, square canvas with 12 percent transparent margin. Studio key light upper left, textured material and strong dimensional shading matching realistic fantasy inventory art. Genuinely transparent alpha background. No floor, cast shadow, text, frame, watermark, hands, or other objects. Not flat vector or crude cylinder.
sourceLookup: Model audit by icon_3d found logs and building timber unsuitable for crafted shafts and shaped handles. Existing itemIconAppearances.ts uses primitive shaft/handle geometry; no genuine matching crafted component model was available.
